name: Introduction and overview — Balao-class Submarine — ship record
title: Introduction and overview — Balao-class Submarine
description: Introduction and overview of the Balao-class Submarine: What this class is, its role in the fleet, and why it matters in naval history. The Balao class — 120 built — improved the Gato with a thicker pressure hull for 400-foot test depth. Balaos were the most numerous U.S. WWII submarine class; USS Archerfish sank the Japanese carrier Shinano, the largest warship ever sunk by a submarine. Many served into the Cold War with GUPPY conversions. Baseline facts: U.S. WWII fleet submarine; 120 built; thicker hull; Archerfish sank Shinano..
how_it_works: Buoyancy supports the hull; propellers driven by diesel, turbine, or nuclear plant provide thrust; rudders and thrusters steer; stability comes from hull form and ballast.
key_points: Balao-class Submarine: What this class is, its role in the fleet, and why it matters in naval history.
U.S. WWII fleet submarine; 120 built; thicker hull; Archerfish sank Shinano.
